thread:
maria_cs: Quick weekly health snapshot for Account: Kestrel Labs — saw a small spike in failures this morning, flags for 5xx + timeouts. attaching quick numbers.

derek_ops: can you paste the top failing endpoints? need to triage before EOD.

ian_sre: top 3 by error volume this window (last 24h):
```
1) /v1/generate -> 45%  (mostly 5xx: 503/504, median latency 520ms)
2) /v1/embeddings -> 30% (timeouts ~12s, client retry floods)
3) /v1/chat/stream -> 15% (rate-limited bursts from parallel sessions)
Other: 10% (misc)
```

nate_se: Kestrel is on Dedicated trial with modest QPS, onboarding scripts running. is this across regions or single region?

ian_sre: noticed majority from us-west-2 (75%). request patterns show long seq lengths causing KV blowups -> increases tail latency -> upstream 503s. also a cascade with client-side retries hitting rate limits.

olivia_pm: renewal touchpoint next week. risk score bumped to 3/5 given latency impact on production flows. pls include remediation notes for customer success call.

maria_cs: noted. immediate ask: can SRE drop a temporary throttle/queue on /v1/generate for this account to reduce retries? also want a list of specific request IDs for support logs.

ian_sre: yes we can apply a short-term 2rps per connection cap and enable 429->backoff header for client. will attach filter rule id in thread.

derek_ops: for escalation, i need the exact error histogram and sample request IDs — @cs-bot can you pull the last 500 logs for kestrel_labs filtered by status>=500?

cs-bot: pulled 500 log lines -> saved to /internal/cs_exports/kestrel/1923456789-logs.tar.gz (link: https://redwood-internal/kestrel/1923456789-logs.tar.gz) :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: thanks. next steps: 1) SRE apply throttle + monitor (ian) 2) CS send mitigation note to customer with ask to implement exponential backoff (maria) 3) PM (olivia) include risk note in renewal deck.

olivia_pm: i'll join the customer call on Wed 10am PT. pls share any repro prompts that spike seq length.

nate_se: quick heads up, onboarding script uses batch size 128 by default. pushing to reduce to 64 reduced failure rate in our test. recommend suggesting that in the playbook.

ian_sre: noted. I'll post a mini runbook after the throttle is in place: root causes, temp mitigations, long-term fix (KV cache sizing + model quantization suggestion).

maria_cs: appreciate the fast turnaround. will update the account health board and send out an email summary after the call. :thumbsup:
